# Script introduction

Southern Africa and Australia hold far more obligate associates than other regions, also within the climates they share with them; the genus-weighted results suggested that they get there differently (`s18`). Following the sixth external review (`writing/research_roadmap.md`, rank 7), this notebook decomposes the obligate share of each fauna, for the biogeographic regions, the five Mediterranean-climate pools and the climate-matched subsets of the Cape, southern Australia and the Mediterranean Basin:

- **S**, the obligate share of the classified species, equals **R × W**: R, the share of species in genera that hold any obligate species; and W, the obligate share within those genera;
- the share of genera holding obligate species; the mutualist and parasite shares; the share of the obligate species in the three largest obligate genera;
- the spread of the obligate-holding genera (median hexagons of about 210,000 km² occupied by the genus worldwide, `s33`).

A **lineage-conserving null** then asks whether a region holds more obligate species than expected from which genera it holds and how strategies are conserved within subfamilies: the obligate share of each genus (over all its classified species) is permuted among the genera of its subfamily, keeping every genus's species in every region; the null share of a region is the species-weighted mean of the permuted genus shares. The observed counterpart uses the genera's own shares. An excess over the null means that a region holds the obligate genera of its subfamilies disproportionately, which the subfamilies present cannot account for; it describes a pattern, not a process. Genus richness is not interpreted as diversification.

A full run takes about 2 min.

# Setup

## Packages

```{r load_packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(resrepo)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Variables

```{r setup_variables}
n_null <- 999
strata_widths <- c(bio01 = 2, bio06 = 3, log_aridity = 0.15, bio15 = 15)   # as in s13 and s18
min_pixels <- 5
min_species_stratum <- 3
pairs <- list(c("Cape", "Mediterranean Basin"), c("Southern Australia", "Mediterranean Basin"),
              c("Cape", "Southern Australia"))
region_levels <- c("Southern Africa", "Australia", "Tropical Africa", "New Guinea and islands", "Indomalayan",
                   "Palearctic", "Nearctic", "Neotropic")
```

## Folders

```{r setup_folders}
dir_s05 <- path_resrepo("data/intermediate/s05_compare_regions")
dir_s13 <- path_resrepo("data/intermediate/s13_compare_matched_climates")
dir_s33 <- path_resrepo("data/intermediate/s33_test_confinement")
dir_data_intermediate <- path_resrepo("data/intermediate/s43_decompose_southern_faunas")
dir.create(dir_data_intermediate, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Functions

```{r load_functions}
source(here::here("code", "R", "write_table.R"))
```

```{r define_helpers}
stratum_of <- function(pix) paste(floor(pix$bio01 / strata_widths[["bio01"]]), floor(pix$bio06 / strata_widths[["bio06"]]),
                                  floor(pix$log_aridity / strata_widths[["log_aridity"]]),
                                  floor(pix$bio15 / strata_widths[["bio15"]]), sep = "_")
# Decomposition of one set of classified species (columns genus, type)
decompose <- function(d, spread) {
  g <- d[, .(n = .N, obl = sum(type %in% c("m", "p"))), by = genus]
  og <- g[obl > 0]
  data.table(species = nrow(d), genera = nrow(g),
             S = mean(d$type %in% c("m", "p")), mutualists = mean(d$type == "m"), parasites = mean(d$type == "p"),
             genera_with_obligate = nrow(og) / nrow(g),
             R = sum(og$n) / nrow(d), W = if (nrow(og)) sum(og$obl) / sum(og$n) else NA_real_,
             top3_share = if (nrow(og)) sum(head(sort(og$obl, decreasing = TRUE), 3)) / sum(og$obl) else NA_real_,
             median_hexagons_obligate_genera = as.numeric(median(spread[og$genus], na.rm = TRUE)))
}
save_figure <- function(plot, name, width, height, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, paste0(name, ".png")), plot,
         width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white", device = ragg::agg_png)
}
theme_figure <- function(base_size = 9) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 1),
          plot.title.position = "plot", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
          legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

```{r keep_setup_objects}
setup_objects <- c(ls(), "setup_objects")
```

# Species sets

The classified species of each biogeographic region (`s05`), of the Mediterranean-climate pixels of each Mediterranean-climate region, and of each region of a pair within the climate strata both occupy (the strata and rules of `s13` and `s18`).

*Inputs:* s05/species_regions.csv; s13/ pixel_strata.rds, record_pixels.rds, taxa.csv
*Outputs:* species_sets.csv

```{r sets}
taxa <- fread(file.path(dir_s13, "taxa.csv"), colClasses = c(pool_key = "character"))[classified == TRUE]
reg <- fread(file.path(dir_s05, "species_regions.csv"), colClasses = c(pool_key = "character"))[
  interaction_type %in% c("n", "f", "m", "p")]
sets <- list(reg[, .(set = "Biogeographic region", unit = region, pool_key, genus, subfamily, type = interaction_type)])
pix <- readRDS(file.path(dir_s13, "pixel_strata.rds"))
rec <- readRDS(file.path(dir_s13, "record_pixels.rds"))
rec[, pool_key := as.character(pool_key)]
cs <- pix[!is.na(med_region)]
cs[, s := stratum_of(cs)]
sp <- unique(merge(rec[cell %in% cs$cell], cs[, .(cell, region = as.character(med_region), s)], by = "cell")[
  , .(region, s, pool_key)])
sp <- merge(sp, taxa[, .(pool_key, genus, subfamily, type = interaction_type)], by = "pool_key")
sets[[2]] <- unique(sp[, .(set = "Mediterranean-climate region", unit = region, pool_key, genus, subfamily, type)])
area <- cs[, .(pixels = .N), by = .(region = as.character(med_region), s)]
for (pr in pairs) {
  occ <- area[region %in% pr & pixels >= min_pixels]
  n_sp <- sp[region %in% pr, .(n = uniqueN(pool_key)), by = .(region, s)]
  ok <- merge(occ, n_sp, by = c("region", "s"))[n >= min_species_stratum]
  s_ok <- ok[, .N, by = s][N == 2]$s
  sets[[length(sets) + 1]] <- unique(sp[region %in% pr & s %in% s_ok,
                                        .(set = paste("Shared climates:", paste(pr, collapse = " vs ")), unit = region,
                                          pool_key, genus, subfamily, type)])
}
sets <- rbindlist(sets)
write_table(sets, file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "species_sets.csv"))
print(sets[, .(species = uniqueN(pool_key), genera = uniqueN(genus)), by = .(set, unit)])
```

```{r clear_sets, include=FALSE}
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), setup_objects))
invisible(gc())
```

# Decomposition and null

*Inputs:* s43/species_sets.csv; s05/species_regions.csv; s33/confinement_genera.csv
*Outputs:* decomposition.csv, null_shares.csv

```{r decompose}
sets <- fread(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "species_sets.csv"), colClasses = c(pool_key = "character"))
cg <- fread(file.path(dir_s33, "confinement_genera.csv"))
spread <- setNames(cg$hexagons, cg$genus)
dec <- sets[, decompose(.SD, spread), by = .(set, unit)]
write_table(dec, file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "decomposition.csv"))
print(dec[, .(set = substr(set, 1, 34), unit, species, genera, S = round(S, 2), R = round(R, 2), W = round(W, 2),
              genera_obl = round(genera_with_obligate, 2), top3 = round(top3_share, 2),
              hex = median_hexagons_obligate_genera)])

# Lineage-conserving null: genus obligate shares (over all classified species of the genus) permuted
# among the genera of each subfamily
reg <- fread(file.path(dir_s05, "species_regions.csv"), colClasses = c(pool_key = "character"))[
  interaction_type %in% c("n", "f", "m", "p") & subfamily != ""]
gshare <- reg[, .(o = mean(interaction_type %in% c("m", "p")), subfamily = subfamily[1]), by = genus]
expected <- function(s, o) {
  e <- merge(s[genus %in% names(o), .N, by = .(set, unit, genus)], data.table(genus = names(o), o = o), by = "genus")
  e[, .(share = sum(N * o) / sum(N)), by = .(set, unit)]
}
o_obs <- setNames(gshare$o, gshare$genus)
obs <- expected(sets, o_obs)
set.seed(43)
null <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(n_null), function(i) {
  perm <- gshare[, .(genus, o = if (.N > 1) sample(o) else o), by = subfamily]
  expected(sets, setNames(perm$o, perm$genus))[, permutation := i]
}))
nul <- merge(obs, null[, .(null_median = median(share), null_low = quantile(share, 0.025),
                           null_high = quantile(share, 0.975)), by = .(set, unit)], by = c("set", "unit"))
nul <- merge(nul, null[obs, on = .(set, unit), .(p_above = mean(share >= i.share)), by = .EACHI], by = c("set", "unit"))
write_table(nul, file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "null_shares.csv"))
print(nul[, .(set = substr(set, 1, 34), unit, expected_from_genera = round(share, 2), null_median = round(null_median, 2),
              null_low = round(null_low, 2), null_high = round(null_high, 2), p_above = round(p_above, 3))])
```

```{r clear_decompose, include=FALSE}
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), setup_objects))
invisible(gc())
```

# Figure

(a) For each fauna, the obligate share S as the product of R (share of species in obligate-holding genera) and W (obligate share within them), with the mutualist and parasite shares. (b) The obligate share expected from the genera of each biogeographic region and Mediterranean-climate region against the lineage-conserving null (95% range).

*Inputs:* s43/ decomposition.csv, null_shares.csv
*Outputs:* plot_southern_decomposition.png

```{r plot_southern_decomposition}
dec <- fread(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "decomposition.csv"))
nul <- fread(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "null_shares.csv"))
dec[, label := fifelse(set == "Biogeographic region" | set == "Mediterranean-climate region", unit,
                       paste0(unit, " (", sub("Shared climates: ", "", set), ")"))]
dec[, set_short := fifelse(grepl("^Shared", set), "Shared climates", set)]
long <- melt(dec, id.vars = c("set_short", "label"), measure.vars = c("R", "W", "S", "mutualists", "parasites"))
long[, variable := factor(variable, c("R", "W", "S", "mutualists", "parasites"),
                          c("R: species in obligate-holding genera", "W: obligate share within them",
                            "S = R x W: obligate share", "Mutualist share", "Parasite share"))]
ord <- dec[order(set_short, S)]$label
long[, label := factor(label, unique(ord))]
fig_a <- ggplot(long, aes(value, label, colour = variable, shape = variable)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_grid(set_short ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#56B4E9", "#0072B2", "#3B3B3B", "#E69F00", "#CC79A7"), name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1, 2, 16, 15, 17), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Share of the classified species", y = NULL, title = "(a) Decomposition of the obligate share") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
  theme_figure(8) + theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
n2 <- nul[!grepl("^Shared", set)]
n2[, unit := factor(unit, n2[order(set, share)]$unit)]
fig_b <- ggplot(n2, aes(y = unit)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = null_low, xmax = null_high), width = 0.3, colour = "grey60", orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(aes(x = null_median), shape = 3, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(aes(x = share), colour = "#D55E00", size = 2.2) +
  facet_grid(set ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Obligate share expected from the region's genera (orange) and under the null (grey)", y = NULL,
       title = "(b) Lineage-conserving null") +
  theme_figure(8) + theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
fig <- patchwork::wrap_plots(fig_a, fig_b, ncol = 2, widths = c(1.2, 1))
save_figure(fig, "plot_southern_decomposition", 11, 7)
fig
```

